subtitle: Gmail reply and selective-notification preview
description: MacOS developer preview: read Gmail, edit a shared reply through Email / Reply / Chat, and review the exact saved reply in the host before sending. Uses host-managed Google authorization and optional consented app-agent tools; credentials stay in the host. Fresh GitHub-published app identity with separate storage/account grants from the legacy sample. Requires contract 1.8.0 / publisher-github-v1 and compatible connected services. Includes fictional local UI states. Publishing and local UI tests do not validate live Google login, provider writes, model behavior or physical approval. Android Google authorization is unavailable; only macOS is advertised.
release_notes: 0.2.0: fresh app ID and GitHub-attested publishing workflow, with no developer signing key. Previous legacy releases remain immutable; no data/account migration. Current unpublished shared Email/Reply/Chat layout preserved. Fresh native screenshots and release-specific validation accompany this version; live provider effects remain unverified.
